name: use-file-upload
title: useFileUpload
description: The file-upload logic behind FileUpload: the fileUpload primitive (definePrimitive) with rows for UI SDK's FileInput (queued, uploading, done, failed, and rejected with the reason in words, duplicates included), a concurrency-limited upload queue with abort, retry and controlled mode, a controller and agent actions (remove, retry, clear, uploadAll), the useFileUpload hook, an XMLHttpRequest adapter that reports real progress, and helpers (describeRules, rejectionMessage; sizes through UI SDK's formatFileSize).
